{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative or shows early signs of pessimism (e.g., -0.25 to -0.50).",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent price spikes — if last 5-7 days show upward momentum, apply a lagged correction to avoid overshoot.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias when sentiment is neutral or mildly positive (0.00–0.25) — reduce forecast drift from recent highs.",
    "When sentiment is strongly positive (≥0.50), slightly overcorrect downward to avoid overconfidence-induced overestimation.",
    "For long-term horizons (>14 days), reduce forecast volatility — sentiment-driven spikes should be dampened with smoothing filters.",
    "If true outcome consistently exceeds forecast by >5% over 3-5 days, apply a downward bias correction to prevent persistent overestimation.",
    "When sentiment shifts from negative to positive within 3 days, initiate a gradual upward correction with 1-2 day lag to avoid abrupt reversal."
  ]
}
